name: Ecologics 2.2.7 (Forge 1.20.1)
changelog:
* Backported several languages.
* Flowering Azalea logs can now be sheared with Crab Claws or items tagged with c:shears
  * The tag c:shears also includes forge:shears
* Moved c and forge tags to be stored in common instead of being modloader-specific. That means no matter if it's Forge or Fabric, you get both c and forge tags. This is done to improve compatibility.
* Adjusted the ordering of creative tab to match vanilla ordering of wooden products.
* Fixed some oddities with placing Moss Carpets onto Moss Layers.

name: Ecologics 2.2.6 (Forge 1.20.1)
changelog:
# 2.2.6 Changes

* Tweaked the drop table of Hanging Coconuts, following similar logic to Coconuts. Still requires being fully grown before it drops anything.
* Creative Mode tab contents are now stored in common code and replicated to Forge and Fabric. Less redundant code.
* Directly placing Moss Layer now results in just one layer instead of two.
* Using hoes on Moss Layer now takes one layer off, minimum of one layer. Cannot be used on full Moss Blocks.
* Moss Layer is now added to creative tab.
* Improved compatibility with Biome Moss mod. Moss Layers and Surface Moss should now adapt to the colours. You might find Surface Moss to be slightly different colours.

# 2.2.5 Changes

* Updated Desert Ruins.
  * The NBT files are updated. Generation code is also adjusted so the sand floor should be more likely to generate 'sunken' and level with the ground.
  * They also now come complete with a layer of sand at the floor and filled with structure void. Suspicious sand is more likely to appear to replace the generated sand floor.
  * Adjusted structural integrity from 90% to 95%.
  * Pots should generate non-waterlogged by default to account for Pots being waterloggable now, unless the ruins generate flooded.
  * Removed old Desert Ruin code. Properly no longer a Feature but a Structure now.
* Updated Coconut Crabs:
  * Coconut Crabs can now breed and as such, now have baby variants. Babies spawn without coconuts as shells.
  * Can be given coconuts as shells if they don't have coconut shells.
  * Is now set as arthropod and as such, Bane of Arthropods enchantment now deals extra damage to coconut crabs.
* Updated Coconuts:
  * Decreased the damage from falling coconuts to be half that of Anvils. Coconuts aren't as heavy as anvils logically.
  * Coconuts can be placed under Coconut Leaves. This will mark the hanging coconut as persistent so it won't fall on its own.
  * Coconuts that fell into water will not break.
  * Breaking Coconuts with axe will cause it to drop Coconut Slices instead of Coconut, unless enchanted with Silk Touch.
  * Now waterloggable.
  * Using pick block on Hanging Coconuts in Creative will clone Coconuts into your hotbar as opposed to not cloning anything.
* Updated Thin Ice:
  * Thin Ice can now be crafted. 2x Ice blocks to 4x Thin Ice blocks.
  * Thin Ice no longer breaks if you move down from 1 block height such as moving down from a slab. Just don't jump!
  * There is now a data-driven list of mobs and entities who can break Thin Ice determined by the tag ecologics:breaks_thin_ice. Players are now no longer the only one who can break thin ices.
* Pot Changes:
  * Now waterloggable.
  * Changed the recipe. Should cost less Terracotta now. Also uses Bricks in recipes.
  * Renamed to Carved Pot to distinguish from Decorated Pots.
* Updated Azalea Flowers:
  * Can be crafted into Magenta Dyes.
  * Can be crafted into Suspicious Stew with Nausea debuff.
  * Brown Mooshrooms can be fed Azalea Flowers.
* Azalea Buttons and Azalea Pressure Plates can now be crafted from Flowering Azalea Planks.
* Azalea Logs and Wood can be converted into their Flowering variants using Azalea Flowers in shapeless crafting.
* Tweaked Flowering Azalea Doors to make the hinges easier to see.
* Coconut Husks can be used as furnace fuel. Same burn time as bowls.
* Various recipes are now given categories.
* Crab Claws should now work for harvesting blocks that drop by shears once again, at least on Fabric.
* Updated Chinese translation files.

name: Ecologics 2.2.4 (Forge 1.20.1)
changelog:
* Re-added and improved Desert Ruins.
* Backported modpack-friendly tag changes and additions from 1.21.1.
* Updated en_us and ru_ru.
* Fixed crash on Fabric. For some reason, the build was wonky.

name: Ecologics 2.2.3 (Forge 1.20.1)
changelog:
* Coconut-plantable blocks are no longer hard-coded and are now defined by block tag: `ecologics:coconut_plantable_on`
* Coconuts can now be planted on the same blocks that all vanilla saplings can be planted on, in addition to usual sand blocks.
* Fixed Coconut and Walnut leaves causing suffocation.
* (Forge) Fixed configs for Azalea trees and Foxes attacking squirrels.

name: Ecologics 2.2.2 (Forge 1.20.1)
changelog:
* Fixed how sign materials are registered.
* Fixed server crashes.

name: Ecologics 2.2.1 (Forge 1.20.1)
changelog:
* Foxes now attack Squirrels, configurable. Foxes will not attack Squirrels on Peaceful difficulty.
* Updated Chinese, Japanese, and Italian language.
* Fixed Turtle Eggs in Sand Castles not hatching.
* Fixed Surface Moss not being dropped if harvested with shears.
* Fixed console spam for falling coconuts.
* Fixed wood type not being properly registered.
* (Forge) Fixed potion recipes on JEI.
* (Fabric) Improved configuration on Fabric for turning off Azalea tree override.
* (Fabric) Coconut Music Disc is now obtainable from buried treasure once again.
